author: SgtJacked
quote: Literally just GTA V.V without prostitutes and added simping and inability to play the way we want to play like kill/attack anyone or date who we want to date and leave the toxic relationship we’re stuck in with Lucia while she expects me to do everything. GTA is still fun to do certain things but they missed the mark completely and didn’t listen to the fans at ALLLLLL…. No wonder they didn’t do a physical disc because so many people would return this game. It’s a lot easier to deny a refund for something digital and that’s already been redeemed… So they keep the money despite everyone’s frustration and disappointment and we’re stuck with no recourse other than to voice our opinions collectively online. I grew up where we could literally destroy anyone despite their race, religion, etc. everyone was fair game because NO ONE was protected. Right, left, gay, bi, straight, etc. everyone was vulnerable and that’s what made it enjoyable because no one was superior to another it was fair play and we could freely express how we decided to express ourselves. This game strips free will away and the development team spent THIRTEEN YEARS making this pathetic excuse ****. They didn’t bother even doing research they hung the drywall incorrectly when fixing up the house like stuff like that no attention to detail on things… I could’ve been a better game and given it the direction needed to be more successful and I certainly wouldn’t “play it safe” with GTA it’s supposed to be unsafe to the highest degree… Definitely going to playing GTA V instead this game doesn’t deserve GOTY that’s for sure and it certainly doesn’t deserve a 10 rating but of course they positive reviews are likely bought and paid for and manipulated to keep pushing this slop. This is a 7 out of 10 at best and even that’s being generous given how long it took them to make.
